song.title: I will sail away
song.lyrics:
[V1] (Verse 1) I will sail away
[V2] In the ocean of the Spirit And there I'll give my praise To the God of my love I will give my praise
[V3] To the God of my life Who understood my soul
[V4] Without any explanation
[V5] (Chorus) Holy Spirit, Spirit
[V6] Descending like a fire Come as in Pentecost
[V7] And fill me with desire
[V8] (Bridge / Refrain) I am free, I am free in You I am free, making all things new In the rhythm, in the soul, I feel Your breath Love has conquered even fear and death
[V9] (Chorus - Repeat) Holy Spirit, Spirit
[V10] Descending like a fire Come as in Pentecost
[V11] And fill me with desire
